verdict.rationale: The core PayPal Agentic Commerce services (cart API, Store Sync, Agent Ready, ACP/UCP integrations) are closed, proprietary, form-gated services with no published source or license; only the client-side 'agent-toolkit' SDK is publicly hosted on GitHub, suggesting some open-source component but not the product itself. Missing for 10: license text for the toolkit repo, any source access for the actual commerce/payment backend, and confirmation the toolkit is the 'product' rather than a thin client wrapper.
